# Northframe

> Northframe is an independent web design and development studio for students, creators, student organizations, and small businesses. It designs and builds affordable, custom, mobile-ready websites with clear pricing, and clients own the finished site and its accounts.

## Pages

- [Home](https://northframebuilds.vercel.app/): what Northframe builds, how the process works, ownership, and package pricing.
- [FAQ](https://northframebuilds.vercel.app/faq): packages, pricing, process, payments, revisions, and ownership.
- [Web design for students](https://northframebuilds.vercel.app/web-design-for-students): portfolio and resume sites.
- [Student organization websites](https://northframebuilds.vercel.app/student-organization-websites): sites for clubs and organizations.
- [Small business websites](https://northframebuilds.vercel.app/small-business-websites): service, team, and contact sites.
- [Portfolio websites for creators](https://northframebuilds.vercel.app/portfolio-websites-for-creators): galleries and project pages.
- [Start a project](https://northframebuilds.vercel.app/start): the project request form (not indexed; a conversion form).
- [Privacy](https://northframebuilds.vercel.app/privacy): what data is collected and how it is handled.
- [Terms](https://northframebuilds.vercel.app/terms): website terms. A separate written agreement covers paid projects.

## Packages

- Launch: one-page site, for student portfolios and resumes.
- Presence: up to three pages, for creators and professionals.
- Business: up to five pages, for organizations and small businesses.
- Custom: quoted by scope, for accounts, databases, payments, dashboards, and integrations.

Current prices are listed on the home page.
